entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Collect copilot session telemetry correlation id #57104
  • dotnetup update should avoid installing older versions when a newer matching version is already installed #57102
  • CA2012 false positive when a ValueTask-returning query expression is returned or awaited #57101

Closed

  • CLI help does not indicate `dotnet store` is deprecated while MSLearn marks `dotnet store` it as such #56789
    Backlog
  • Visual Studio: solution template with .slnx primary output not detected on volumes without 8.3 short names (ReFS Dev Drive), projects added flat instead #56391
  • SDK msbuild tasks aren't shipping their deps.json file #39034
  • [AI discovered CI] dotnet-watch test host crashes during ServerAndResources #57065
  • [Known Build Error] F# sample template snapshot mismatch after unversioned package update #57031

PullRequests

Created

  • Verify downloaded template packages #57112
  • Report missing inputs for no-build single-file publishing #57111
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Escape localized restore errors in package list JSON #57110
    backport
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.2xx' => 'main' #57109
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.2xx' => 'release/dnup' #57108
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Migrate test package feeds to dotnet-public #57107
  • Collect copilot telemetry correlation - fixes #57104 #57106
  • Add dynamic generic-help parity guardrails and skill guidance #57103
  • Run GenerateAssemblyInfo before XamlPreCompile #57100
  • [wasm] Restore Crossgen2 for CoreCLR browser publish defaults #57099
  • Report CA2007 for await foreach with WithCancellation #57094

Merged

  • Fix flaky cross-entry-point telemetry drain lease assertion #57105
  • Escape localized restore errors in package list JSON #57083
    Servicing-consider
  • Indicate `dotnet store` deprecation in CLI help #56956
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Stabilize unrelated CI tests #57093
  • Use Azure Linux 4 for Helix queues #57072
    Servicing-consider
  • Optimize top-level command help parsing #56267
  • Harden container registry authentication redirects #57092
  • Fix dotnet-new template samples test and dotnet-watch .slnx sharing violation #57089

Updated

  • dotnetup: stop Windows installer downgrades from turning into failed repairs #57016
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56869
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56846
  • [dotnet watch] Use the selected device's RuntimeIdentifier when evaluating and building projects #56723
  • Make ProjectAssetsFile available in cross-targeting builds #57006
  • Escape literal output paths before forwarding to MSBuild #56972
    breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created
  • Fix cancellation rollback and Run API stdin handling #56979
  • Use proper Registry Lookup for 64 Bit Machines in `dotnetup` #57051
  • Unify dotnetup repository requirements and install-spec resolution #56798
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Distinguish Copilot CLI and VS Code detection #57038
    Servicing-approved
  • Plumb CancellationToken through all CLI commands for consistent Ctrl+C/SIGTERM behavior #56332
  • Add CDN publishing pipeline for dnup #56844
  • Resolve named dotnetup channels to the greatest eligible release #56800
  • Simplify dotnetup uninstall to remove command-line requirements #56799
  • Avoid mutating shared command metadata when rendering help #56974
  • Show --property in dotnet build help #56973
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Fix dotnet watch crash after switching target frameworks #57088
    Servicing-consider
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57086
